captureContract.inputInjection: PostMessageW(WM_KEYDOWN, vkCode, 0x00000001) + PostMessageW(WM_KEYUP, vkCode, 0xc0000001) to the PID-filtered Chocolate Doom window handle; SetForegroundWindow is called before each key burst so SDL 1.2's message pump processes the synthesized events.
captureContract.captureMode: GDI BitBlt against the live Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 SDL window after each scripted key hold settles for settleAfterKeyMs (default 400ms).
captureContract.liveCaptureGate: test/plan_final/oracle/capture-reference-e1m1-actions.test.ts unconditionally pins the static surface (runner + normalizer + SCRIPTED_E1M1_ACTION_KINDS frozen 6-element list + SCRIPTED_E1M1_ACTION_SEQUENCES frozen 6-entry record with per-action keyHolds contracts + override key set + error class shape) and gates the live capture on every REFERENCE_SANDBOX_POLICY.requiredFiles entry being present; when gated in, the live test runs the 'movement' sequence end-to-end (~56 scripted tics of forward + turn-right after reaching E1M1) and asserts the full evidence record including per-hold framebuffer hashes.
